title: プログラミング基礎（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Fundamentals of Programming
educationalGoal:
Computer systems are constructions of hardware and software technology. This course focuses on the software side of the combination.
Programming is the skill used to create software, and knowledge regarding it also helps users employ software effectively.
Since the C language is widely used currently, this course teaches students about software design concepts through the practice of C programming.
advice:
In this course, students will learn the software design concepts by programming, debugging, compiling, and running sample programs.

The evaluation results of exams and reports will be reported to students, who will then be encouraged and required to use those results to improve their skills. Specifically, students in this course will learn about the following topics:

・Fundamental programming procedures
・Variable and type declarations
・Input, output, and calculation
・Branch and repetition
・Function
・File processing
・Pointer and structure
requiredKnowledge:
The installation of a development environment will be covered during the first class and each student must establish the environment before the second class.

Students will be expected to write source code during in the class, so advanced keyboard skills are expected.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the programming syntax of C.
Be able to program applications capable of handling numerous numbers, letters, and data.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Be able to achieve over 80% of the target student abilities.

(2) Be able to acquire a satisfactory understanding of the concepts of variables, calculations, branch, and repetition.

(3) Be able acquire a satisfactory understanding of the concept of functions and structures.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Achieve over 60% of the target student abilities.

(2) Be able acquire a basic understanding of variables, calculations, branch, and repetition.

(3) Be able to acquire a basic understanding of the concepts of functions and structures.

・Fundamental programming procedures
